chunks: Then why do you dissimulate this Revelation?

key_terms.أَفَبِهَٰذَا: Then with this / So with this
key_terms.الْحَدِيثِ: The word, speech, or revelation being discussed
key_terms.مُدْهِنُونَ: Those who are cautious, dissimulating, or giving a little here and there

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be 'mudhinun' regarding the Hadith in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the superficial acceptance of the Quran by those who treat it as mere folklore or entertainment rather than a serious guide for life. The term 'hadith' here refers to the divine revelation itself, highlighting the disconnect between hearing the message and internalizing its weight. This serves as a warning against the complacency of the elite who acknowledge the truth but fail to act upon it.
